strengths: Character identity is preserved exactly: blue helmet with gold crest and red plume, blue plate armor with gold edges, gold chest cross, chainmail at elbows, brown belt with gold buckle and pouch
Clear, readable waving-hello gesture with an open, empty gloved hand at head height; five fingers, no extra digits
Round red shield with gold rim, rivets and fleur-de-lis is held on the other arm and matches the reference
Friendly open smile with the same face design as the reference
Outline weight, cel shading, chibi proportions and palette match the reference; plain light-gray background, no text or artifacts
Centered with padding on all sides; silhouette reads well at small size

issues.description: Framed as a full-body figure rather than a tighter character-portrait crop; the face and waving hand occupy a relatively small part of the frame for a portrait
The three-quarter turn is subtle; torso and feet are close to frontal, almost identical to the reference stance
No hand or grip is visible behind the shield, so the shield looks pinned to the forearm rather than actively held
Lower body and leg pose are copied almost verbatim from the reference, making the new pose feel less natural and less dynamic

suggestedCorrections: Crop to a knees-up or waist-up portrait so the smiling face and waving hand fill more of the frame, keeping padding around the plume, hand and shield
Rotate the torso and hips more clearly toward the viewer's right so the far shoulder is partly hidden, giving an unmistakable front three-quarter view
Show the gloved fingers of the shield hand gripping the shield's edge or strap
Give the legs a relaxed new stance with weight on one leg instead of repeating the reference stance
